site.title: Raw milk direct sales calculator
site.description: Free calculator for dairy farmers: compare selling raw milk directly, from a vending machine or farm shop, with delivering it to the dairy.
site.disclaimer: Estimate, not financial or legal advice.
site.noscript: This calculator needs JavaScript to work.

method.title: Method
method.intro: This page lists everything the calculator does: the formulas, the starting values and where the dairy price comes from.
method.formulasIntro: Direct sales are compared with delivering the same milk to the dairy. The dairy price is therefore counted as a cost of every litre sold directly.

terms.dairyPricePerL: The dairy price converted from € per 100 kg to € per litre. One litre of milk weighs about 1.03 kg.
terms.marginPerSoldLitre: What one litre sold directly earns more than a litre delivered to the dairy, after payment fees, the bottle and the milk that was loaded but not sold.
terms.annualFixed: Costs that do not depend on the volume sold: your time, electricity, maintenance, lab tests and insurance.
terms.annualMargin: Extra margin per year compared with the dairy, after fixed costs.
terms.paybackMonths: Months needed for the extra margin to cover the investment. If the annual margin is zero or negative, the investment does not pay back.
terms.breakEvenLitresDay: Litres to sell per day for the annual margin to be exactly zero.
terms.targetLitresDay: Litres to sell per day to recover the investment within the payback target.
terms.cashFlow: Cumulative cash flow for each month from 0 to 60, starting at minus the investment.

method.edgeCases: If the margin per litre sold is zero or negative, the break-even and target volumes are shown as "not profitable at this price".
method.scenariosText: Three scenarios are calculated. Expected uses your figures as entered. Pessimistic uses {down} fewer litres and {waste} percentage points more unsold milk. Optimistic uses {up} more litres.
method.defaultsIntro: Every starting value can be changed in the calculator. Values marked as not yet verified are placeholders until a reliable source is found.
method.dataText: Dairy prices come from the raw milk price data of the European Commission's Agri-food Data Portal: monthly prices per member state, for conventional and organic milk, in € per 100 kg.
method.dataChecks: Each value is checked before it is published. A value is rejected if it is outside {min}–{max} € per 100 kg, if its month is more than {months} months old, or if it differs by {change} or more from the previous value. In that case the previous value stays and is marked as outdated.
method.dataFallback: Where no organic price is published, the conventional price is used. Where a country has no recent price at all, a neighbouring country's price is used. The calculator says so in both cases.
method.disclaimerText: The results depend entirely on the figures entered. Check them with your accountant, and check the rules for selling raw milk with your food safety authority.
